4.7star [...] You can use duplicate stickers either for trading or for rewards. Duplicate stickers show up as sticker stars based on their rarity (e.g. a 5-star duplicate appears as 5 stars). Tap the safe icon in your album to trade sticker stars for vault rewards: [...] 1–3 star stickers: Most common, available in green, yellow, and pink packs. You can trade them frequently or convert duplicates into sticker stars.
 4–5 star stickers: Rarer. Often appear in blue and purple packs.
 Gold stickers: Extremely rare, typically found in higher-tier packs or events like Golden Blitz. Gold stickers offer extra rewards and only trade within limited windows.
